items.title: Phenotype Pipeline
items.alt_zh: 输入表型、基因型与环境数据，进行质控及基因型与环境双编码分支，经交叉注意力融合与G×E交互，通过预测头输出，评估观测预测散点、精度及逐地点交叉验证。
items.alt_en: Phenotype, genotype, environment inputs. QC. Genotype and environment encode branches. Cross attention fuse and G×E. Prediction head. Observed predicted scatter, accuracy, leave site CV.
items.desc_zh: Python脚本生成可编辑SVG，含4个带矢量备用的AI图标。提供SVG和PNG下载，脚本见docs/house-style/arch/。
items.desc_en: Python script editable SVG. 4 AI icons each with vector fallback. PNG 2000×1324. Download SVG, PNG. Script at docs/house-style/arch/.

items.title: Plotting Pipeline
items.alt_zh: 图示依次为数据输入、调用theme_house()应用主题、调用pv_save_house()保存函数，最终输出PDF与PNG格式文件。
items.alt_en: Diagram shows data input, applying theme_house(), calling pv_save_house(), and outputting PDF and PNG files.
items.desc_zh: 数据经theme_house与pv_save_house输出PDF和PNG。由draw.io制作，可下载SVG、PNG与.drawio。
items.desc_en: Pipeline passes data to theme_house() then pv_save_house() to output PDF and PNG. Made in draw.io. Download SVG, PNG, .drawio.

items.desc_en: Panel letters 10 pt, axis titles 8 pt, ticks 7 pt, min 6 pt. +2 pt for single 2×2 89×89 mm. draw.io. Download SVG, PNG, .drawio.
